scheme_name: Scheme For Award Of Senior/Junior Fellowships To Outstanding Persons In The Fields Of Culture
other_conditions: Applicants must be aged above 40 for Senior Fellowship or between 25 and 40 for Junior Fellowship (age as of 1 April).
Senior Fellowship applicants must not be receiving a pension under the Ministry of Culture’s grant for indigent artists.
Applicants must not have previously received the same fellowship; a former Junior Fellow can apply for Senior Fellowship after a 5‑year gap after project closure.

If employed in a government department or institution, the applicant must obtain leave for the two‑year fellowship period and submit the application through the head of the department with written assurance.
Fellows must submit six‑monthly progress reports; failure to do so may result in withholding of further payments.
The research project must be completed within two years, with a possible three‑month extension without additional cost.
benefits_summary: Senior fellows receive ₹20,000 per month and junior fellows ₹10,000 per month for two years, with a possible one‑time grant up to ₹20,000 or 50 % of publication cost.
